coco.selection_rule: sorted eligible image ids, then numpy.default_rng(1701).shuffle
coco.eligibility: non-crowd annotations; largest annotation is target; at least one different-category distractor; target area fraction in [0.02, 0.8]

voc2007.selection_rule: sorted test image ids, then numpy.default_rng(1701).shuffle
voc2007.eligibility: largest object is target; at least one different-category distractor; target area fraction in [0.02, 0.8]

intervention.attention_logit_columns: selected patch key/value columns set to -inf for every query; CLS retained

selection.wf: argmax over epsilon-feasible candidates of selection target drop minus max non-target foil drop
selection.mean: argmax over epsilon-feasible candidates of selection target drop minus mean non-target foil drop
selection.max_0_1: argmax over epsilon-feasible candidates of selection target drop minus 0.1 times max non-target foil drop

bootstrap.paired_difference: candidate minus CCI on the same image before resampling
